name: timeline_editor_range_map
description: Map an exact half-open interval between source and sequence time, or between group and assembly time. Returns all matching pieces in output order, including repeats. Supply a history token and index together to query a retained review state.

project_handle.description: Opaque live document handle from project_windows_list.

expected_revision.description: Current live document revision. Pins the request and subsequent pages.

history_index.description: Zero-based state index in the retained history returned by history_read. The cursor selects the current state.

history_token.description: History token from a fresh history_read.

offset.description: Start at this result row. Use next_offset from the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum result rows per page. Defaults to 100.

file.description: Exact playable or original sequence source path. Omit to match every source.

occurrence_index.description: Limit to one zero-based timeline occurrence in the selected revision.

name: history_editor_compare
description: Compare a retained undo or redo state with the current timeline without moving the history cursor. Reports affected occurrences and participant changes with source IDs, tile IDs, and source intervals where applicable. The page limit covers occurrence and participant rows together.
